g.title: G
g.text: V/Q ≈ 0.8 · SaO₂ 95–100% · FEV1/FVC < 0.70 = obstructive · step up at 2+/week · TB 8 + 18 weeks

g.title: mech
g.text: Recoil pushes air out · low compliance = more work
Pleural surface tension holds lungs open

g.title: alv
g.text: Cl⁻ → Na⁺ → water thins mucus (CF: CFTR)
Type I thin · type II surfactant (soap)

g.title: pft
g.text: FVC = how much air the lungs hold
FEV1 = air out in 1 s (conducting pathways)

g.title: gas
g.text: Left shift in lungs · CADET face Right

g.title: res
g.text: Can't hold air · FEV1 & FVC fall, ratio holds
Effusion: exudate pulls fluid · ARDS: prone

g.title: upper
g.text: Guaifenesin + water · antihistamines don't help a cold

g.title: tb
g.text: 4 drugs × 8 wk → 2 × 18 wk · latent INH 9 mo
Liver · red fluids · B6 for neuropathy · DOT
